title: Isibhengezo Sesono Esingazange Sibonwe Ngaphambili
intro: Amanye amabali kwiQuran atyhila ubunzulu bokonakala olunokuthi uluntu lonke luwele kuko. Lo mthunywa wema yedwa, ebongoza abantu abatshoniswe bubugwenxa obungazange bulandelwe luhlanga ngaphambili. Nangona iminyaka yesilumkiso, iintliziyo zahlala zilukhuni, kwaye umyalelo kaThixo wafika ngendlela eyoyikekayo. Ungamchaza lo mthunywa uhloniphekileyo ka-Allah?
clues: Ndathunyelwa njengomlumkisi kubantu abadla ubomi obugwenxa obungazange bubekho ngaphambili.
Abantu bam bandibiza ngokuba ndilixoki kwaye bandisongela ngokugxotha abalandeli bam kunye nam kweli lizwe.
Iindwendwe ezihloniphekileyo zeza ekhayeni lam zifana namadoda aselula abethayo, ndaza ndaziva ndikhathazekile kakhulu ngenxa yokhuseleko lwazo.
Abantu bam bafune ukuba ndibanike iindwendwe zam, bengazi ukuba ezi ndwendwe ziingelosi ezithunyelwe ngu-Allah.
Iqabane lam alizange libe nokholo lwam, laza lakhetha ukusala ngasemva nabantu abagwetyiweyo.
Ndasindiswa kunye neentombi zam ekuzeni kokusa, njengoko imvula enkulu yamatye yayina kwaye izixeko zethu zabhukuqwa.

arabic: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verse: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims. (51:36)
